summary: direct-Q＋grouped四行max通过CPU编译与独立FP DAG/资源审阅，批准仅一次pure2048增量组件A/B（A=direct-Q v2，B=组合）；SGPR99/VGPR107、64KiB shared、2处scalar spill、无VGPR/private spill。未跑GPU，无数值/性能/模型/生产/官方资格，也不继承151702资格。
scope: 仅批准一次pure2048增量组件实验；不授数值、性能、模型、生产或官方资格。

evidence.loop_recurrence: All 45 phi nodes have the same incoming predecessor edges and recursively normalized incoming expressions as the direct-Q parent; ordered roots for all 64 MMA operations and all 48 final BF16 truncations match.
evidence.softmax_and_output: FMA roots are the same multiset (schedule reordered); fadd/fmul/fsub/fdiv/select/fptrunc dataflow roots match as multisets. Per-row max operand order and P/rho/L/acc recurrence are unchanged; the only intended scheduling change is issuing four independent row shuffles before consuming them at each max-tree distance.
evidence.q_and_kv_lifecycle: Q initialization remains the same 32 ushort loads, 16 byte permutes and 16 waits as the parent. The 32 SME prefetches enter the existing QK/softmax/PV path; original drain and all three barriers remain. No new Q shared stage or early drain.

limits: 必须仍通过本次组件预声明的数值、全storage/Graph/side-stream/ABBA门。
不继承151702资格；出现launch错误须停止并传播错误。
